text:
amy (sales): Ran the EdgeFlow POC stress run overnight, quick notes below.
jon (eng): thanks — can you drop the results?
amy (sales): quick summary: p95 98ms for short prompts (<=32 tokens) at sustained 600 qps; mid (128 tokens) p95 ~220ms at 400 qps; long prompts (512 tokens) p95 820ms at ~150 qps. p99 long-tail spikes up to 1.6s during simulated region failover.
mira (perf-engineer): noted — we saw KV-cache miss cascades during the failover which amplified tail.
sam (solutions): customer is asking for committed capacity pricing given these numbers. they want per-1k-token cost and a dedicated-pool scenario.
jon (eng): roughback-of-envelope: 1 dedicated pool (8xA100) serving mixed workload with current batching -> ~ $0.45 per 1k tokens. this assumes 70% sustained util and current autoscale config.
amy (sales): include multi-region redundancy premium and HSM/KMS add-on in that calc — they called out KMS latency as a blocker in the security questionnaire.
mira (perf-engineer): reproducer we used:
```bash
loadgen --target http://pocexport:8080/generate \
  --model redwood-13b-quant --qps 600 --seq-dist "short:0.6,mid:0.3,long:0.1" \
  --concurrency 250 --headers "Authorization: Bearer TOKEN"
```
jon (eng): logs during the failover window:
```text
[2026-03-20T03:12:09Z] 502 upstream reset
[2026-03-20T03:12:09Z] routing: fallback to model redwood-13b-int8
[2026-03-20T03:12:10Z] resp-latency p99=1612ms
```
amy (sales): what are the enterprise blockers we need to resolve before sign?
sam (solutions): Sec team asks: HSM-backed key rotation policy, per-customer VPC peering, failover SLA <30s, and documented SOC2 evidence. also they want a sample runbook for incident ops.
mira (perf-engineer): perf fixes we recommend: enable per-customer KV caching (reduce cross-tenant cold misses), drop KV TTL to 30s for hot prefixes, and turn on dynamic batching heuristics for long-sequence requests. should reduce long-prompt p95 ~30%.
jon (eng): operational suggestion: deploy `redwood-13b-quant-v2` in the fallback tier — sacrifice ~1% output quality for ~2x throughput on long prompts. good trade for bursty tails.
amy (sales): the customer asked for a one-pager with: latency table (short/mid/long), cost/GPU estimate, security answers, and a failover runbook. who can produce each section?
sam (solutions): I’ll draft security answers and the runbook. @mira can you produce the perf table and recommended config? @jon please add the cost spreadsheet numbers.
mira (perf-engineer): on it — aiming for first draft by EOD PST.
ops-bot: Canary failover test completed: automatic region failover executed, recovery within 19s, no data leakage detected. See #eng-sre for raw traces.
amy (sales): perfect — sending a heads-up to the customer contact. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
